name: claudespotter
description: Shows each running subagent's model, effort and context bar above the agent list, with a toast on spawn and bar styles in /config

barStyle.title: Bar style
barStyle.description: The look of each subagent's context bar. blocks: █ on ░, the tip easing by eighths of a cell while the bar grows. parallelogram: ▰ on ▱. shade: ▓ on ░. solid: █ on a gray █. smooth: █ on ░, the edge always by eighths of a cell. smooth-bare: the same on blank. line: ━ on ─. heavy: a bold ━ on a dim ━. dots: ● on ○. squares: ■ on □. diamonds: ◆ on ◇. braille: ⣿ on ⣀. ascii: # on - between [ and ], for fonts without these glyphs. arrow: ===> between [ and ]. pie: one glyph, ○ ◔ ◑ ◕ ●. spark: one glyph, ▁ to █. none: no bar, the percent alone.

barWidth.title: Bar width
barWidth.description: How many cells each subagent's context bar takes: 3 to 20. pie, spark and none ignore it.

motion.title: Motion
motion.description: How the rows move. lively: the bars glint when they change, the fill grows and blends its color, the percent and the tokens roll, crossing 50% or 80% pulses the bar and past 80% the dot pulses red, a compaction drains the bar with sparkles, each tool call flashes its name at the end of the row, and the running dot spins ◐ ◓ ◑ ◒ every 0.2 s. subtle: softer glints, no sparkles, the spinner a step every second. off: still rows; the elapsed time still updates every second.
